problems.title: Shared date parser reads day-first tenants' dates month first
problems.summary: The shared parser reads every typed date month first, so a day-first tenant's bookings land on the day and month exchanged (parser cause in causes.ts).

problems.title: booking-v3 form hint prints MM/DD/YYYY but the field is read day first
problems.summary: booking-v3 prints the hint MM/DD/YYYY under its date field, people type month first, and the form reads it the tenant's day-first way, exchanging day and month (hint cause in causes.ts).

problems.title: Booking date shows one day earlier on some surfaces and for some recipients
problems.summary: A booked date is shown one calendar day earlier, weekday moving with it and month unchanged, on one surface or to one recipient but not another; consistent with a date-only booking rendered as a timestamp across a timezone or date boundary. A day/month swap cannot produce this.
